instructions_to_main_agent: Install and integrate required npm libraries if missing: lenis (@studio-freight/lenis or lenis), framer-motion, lucide-react, react-fast-marquee, canvas-confetti, etc.
Implement the FastAPI backend endpoint `/api/lead` or `/api/diagnostico` to save lead diagnostic inquiries to DB.
Ensure all interactive buttons and inputs carry `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid="hero-cta-button"`, `data-testid="whatsapp-floating-button"`).
Maintain high visual density with Linear/Vercel inspired subtle border lines (`border-gray-800`), glowing emerald live badges (`#10B981`), and electric blue CTAs (`#2563EB`).
Provide responsive mobile navigation menu with smooth transitions.
Include a sticky floating WhatsApp button on the bottom right with a subtle breathing green pulse effect.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never center align the root application container.
Avoid generic AI slop centered layouts. Use bold asymmetry, crisp typography, layered z-indexes, and subtle noise/grid textures.
Ensure APCA text contrast compliance on all dark surfaces.
Use micro-interactions on all cards and interactive widgets.
